title.en: Ayusi remembered after the 1755 Ili campaign
title.zh: 1755年伊犁战役后的阿玉锡形象

alt.en: A mounted soldier carries a long lance across a pale handscroll, between imperial calligraphy, red seals and a written account.
alt.zh: 浅色手卷中，骑兵持长矛策马，左右有御题书法、红色印章与文字叙述。

caption.en: Giuseppe Castiglione painted Ayusi in 1755 after his raid on Dawachi’s camp. The Qianlong emperor’s accompanying text presents the soldier’s achievement from the Qing court’s viewpoint. This is a commemorative court portrait, not an eyewitness image of combat.
caption.zh: 郎世宁于1755年阿玉锡袭击达瓦齐营地后奉命绘像。乾隆帝的配文从清廷角度表彰战功。这是纪功宫廷肖像，并非战场实录。

interpretation.en: The rider stands out against an empty ground, framed by imperial writing. Portrait and praise turn military service into an image of merit, showing how the Qing court commemorated this campaign.
interpretation.zh: 空白背景突出骑者，御题文字环绕其侧。肖像与赞词把军旅经历塑造成受表彰的功勋，显示清廷如何纪念这场战役。

items.creator: Giuseppe Castiglione (Lang Shining); imperial inscriptions by the Qianlong emperor
items.date: 1755; court portrait commissioned after the campaign
